text: マチスは　へやの　スイッチを　なにかの…　そこに　かくしたと　いってたな

structure.jp: へやの　スイッチを
なにかの…　そこに　かくしたと
structure.en: that he hid (them) at the... bottom of something

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.span: そこに　かくしたと　いってた
patterns.explanation: と after some words shows that they are what someone said. かくしたと いってた = 'he said he hid them'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: いってた is the short spoken form of いっていた, 'was saying'. いってた = 'he was saying'.

patterns.name: 〜な
patterns.explanation: な at the end shows the speaker is thinking back and half talking to himself. いってたな = 'he was saying that, come to think of it'.
